turns.q: Hi! I'm looking for a gift for someone and I'm not sure what to pick, can you help?
turns.replyTail: r easy win. To gift an IPSY subscription: 1. Log in to your IPSY account or visit IPSY.com. 2. Click the gift banner at the top of the page (or open the menu). 3. Choose IPSY Original or IPSY Extra, then pick a 3-, 6-, or 12-month plan. 4. Enter the recipient’s name and email, and choose when the gift email should be sent. 5. Complete checkout. You don’t need to be subscribed to buy a gift subscription, and gift subscriptions are currently only available for recipients within the contiguous U.S.
